commits.message:
fix(renderables): every exported renderable ends its own line or is listed as a fragment (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq) (#229)

* fix(renderables): every exported renderable ends its own line or is listed as a fragment (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq)

Spinner, Status, Pretty, JSON and a Layout leaf left their last line open,
so a Group ran what followed onto it; Rich ends all five. test/seam/line-ends.ts
derives every exported Renderable class and requires an entry saying which
side of the line it sits on, rendering each to check. ProgressBar, Emoji and
the Progress columns are fragments, as in Rich.

* fix(line-ends): a column is not a renderable; containers end where their content does (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq)

Review (high) of #229:
- ProgressColumn no longer extends Renderable and takes a required task,
  as Rich's is a callable of one; the columns leave the renderable
  universe and their `task?.` guards go with the optional parameter.
- LINE_ENDS gains a `content` kind for Group and Constrain, drawn around
  an ended and an open content, instead of an own-line claim their
  fixtures only happened to satisfy.
- One exported-renderables universe (test/seam/exported-renderables.ts)
  for both the line-ends and ascii-only gates.
- JSONRenderable ends its line through its RichText's `end`, one place.
- Status's unobservable line end is dropped; the gate header no longer
  claims Status ran on in a Group.
- rich-explore lays its ProgressBars out in a grid, one row each.
- docs/group.md names fragments by example, not as a list.
